package.description: The Playback File Add-On allows streaming in data from any supported LabChart file (including imported data formats such as EDF and WAV), as if the data were coming live from an attached device.

en-US.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
en-US.description: The Playback File Add-On allows streaming in data from any supported LabChart file (including imported data formats such as EDF and WAV), as if the data were coming live from an attached device.
en-US.longDescription: The Playback File Add-On allows streaming in data from any supported LabChart file (including imported data formats such as EDF and WAV), as if the data were coming live from an attached device. This allows you to mimic real-life recording situations using previously recorded data.

package.longDescription: The Playback File Add-On allows streaming in data from any supported LabChart file (including imported data formats such as EDF and WAV), as if the data were coming live from an attached device. This allows you to mimic real-life recording situations using previously recorded data.
